annotations.title: Find an act in the catalog

description: DOES THIS ACT EXIST, and what are its official details — number, issuing body, publication date, Monitorul Oficial number, the date it entered into force, how many articles it has, whether it is still in force. Searches the CATALOG of acts, not their text: use it for 'was Legea 141/2025 published', 'which government decision set the minimum wage', 'the norms of the trade register'. `subject` is what the act is about, in Romanian, in any wording: title and subject line are both searched, in any word order and inflection; when no act has every word, those with all but one follow, then acts by meaning — each fallback labelled. Every act carries a law="…" handle for lookup_article and get_act_structure, and an approving order is shown with the act it approves. For provisions ON a topic use search_semantic instead; this returns acts, not articles. `pending` reaches versions already published that do not apply yet.

emitent.description: Issuing body, e.g. 'PARLAMENTUL', 'GUVERNUL', 'MINISTERUL FINANTELOR', or its acronym: 'ANAF' (the ANAF orders), 'CCR', 'ICCJ', 'BNR', 'ASF'.

in_force.description: Restrict to acts in force (true) or not in force (false).

pending.description: Return versions already published that do not apply yet (viitoare) rather than the text currently in force.

subject.description: What the act is about, in Romanian, in any wording — e.g. 'salariul minim brut', 'norme registrul comerțului', 'tarifele notarilor'. Title and subject line are both searched.

name: find_act
